principles: A negative result is unattributed until a positive control through the same address shows a known-present payload (written 09-16, violated again 09-17).
status/FAVORABLE/typecheck/landed:true is not evidence; read the landed diff region (0d86170 traded away an oracle while green).
Never quote reach without splitting by author: operator 80% vs autonomous 0.9-2.6% on 09-13; operator dispatches contaminate the denominator.
A single reading cannot distinguish a level from a point on a drain curve; a flat line proves nothing if the window starts after the step.
Pre-register and control for spontaneous recovery: a landed fix during a drain would have manufactured causal evidence (09-17).
Retention is not reclamation, at every layer (SurrealDB 37GB/4.6GB; Docker.raw 922G/399G).
User: docs must state invariants and failure modes; names, tables and implementation details are irrelevant and subject to change.
User: nothing should fail the same way every time; identical failures count as independent samples, and the system must understand causality.
User: a fully autonomous system tries alternate routes and verifies it reached; no SPOF may block it.
User: it is not known until it is a trend, not a sample.
User: every learning write needs a demonstrated reader; if the operator supplies the diagnosis, that intervention is the next missing capability.
Crystallization compounds exactly as far as deterministic grading extends (boundary law, 09-18).
Information at the right time is measurable: supplying edit_site moved predicted_p 0.5->0.7, and dictated diffs land where prose fails, but depending on dictation is itself the gap (law 13).
A writer that pins a peer cannot learn the peer was replaced; liveness must prove the socket, not the heartbeat.
The same finding recurs under new names: path_signature keying (09-05 and 09-16), judge fail-open (09-05 and 09-15), push PAT (09-14 and 09-18), 'root cause of everything' twice (09-17 and 09-18).
